Lakewood Ranch Visitors Kept Feeding the Gators. Now Four of Them Are Gone.

A viral video of a gator leaping at a bridge full of snack-holding humans ended the way these things always end: badly for the gator.

Lakewood Ranch says four alligators had to be removed from Kingfisher Lake at Waterside Place this month after people kept feeding them, including restaurant staff and patrons. A viral video showed one gator leaping toward people on a bridge. Waterside Place says the gators went to a farm to be processed for meat and hides.
